race.description: More From Tote With Ladbrokes Hcp (Bm62)
race.comment: BLUE HUMMA (5) resumes. He showed ability in two runs over the Winter, winning narrowly on debut when backed into $1.75 before a good effort at Sandown Hillside. Only a short spell leading in and he can continue to progress. PRESSCODE (3) has come back with a bang, winning two in a row over this trip. He maps for every chance to go again. STREET CONQUEROR (7) resumes. He's jumped out quite well and has the ability to mix it with these, suspect he'll be a price as well. FEHMARN (2) won well two back at Bendigo, solid last time in town. This suits nicely although he's been up a while for his first campaign. EGERTON (8) can improve off two even runs this campaign.
